papers.title: Distribution and Effects of Model Palladium-Doped Nanoplastics in the Marine Mussel Mytilus galloprovincialis
papers.authors: González-Soto, Nagore; Schirinzi, Gabriella F.; Bucher, Guillaume; Bilbao, Eider; Orbea, Amaia; Mehn, Dora; Gilliland, Douglas; Serra, Miguel-Ángel; Mitrano, Denise M.; Passos, Marisa Sárria Pereira de
papers.abstract: While nanoplastics (NPs, <1 µm) concentration is anticipated to increase in the marine environment, the analytical tools for NP quantification and data on their impacts are still scarce. This work aimed to expand knowledge regarding bioaccumulation and effects of NPs on the sentinel organism Mytilus galloprovincialis. For this, mussels were dietarily exposed for 7 days to model palladium-doped-polystyrene NPs (Pd-PS NPs) of 142.6 ± 1.0 nm at 1 × 109 Pd-PS NPs/mL. ICP-MS analysis on water samples showed that after one day of exposure no Pd was detected suggesting that mussels cleared the NPs. After 7 days of exposure, 14% of the Pd introduced in the tanks was found in feces. Less than 0.02% passed into the hemolymph of mussels and consequently, no responses were observed on hemocytes. Approximately 1% of the Pd was found in soft tissues. This could be linked to the significantly higher prevalence of digestive tubule atrophy observed in exposed mussels in comparison to controls. No effects were observed at the whole organism level. In conclusion, mussels were able to uptake and to eliminate Pd-PS NPs through feces. Whether longer exposures could cause a significant accumulation of NPs and produce associated biological effects remains to be studied.
papers.summary_cn: 以模式生物紫贻贝（Mytilus galloprovincialis）为对象，通过7天膳食暴露实验研究了钯掺杂聚苯乙烯纳米塑料（Pd-PS NPs，142.6 nm）的分布与生物效应。ICP-MS分析显示，贻贝可通过粪便有效清除NPs（7天后14%的Pd经粪便排出），仅约1%进入软组织、不足0.02%进入血淋巴，未在血细胞和整体生物水平引起显著响应，但暴露组消化管萎缩发生率显著升高。研究表明贻贝能摄取并排出Pd-PS NPs，长期暴露的累积效应有待进一步研究。

papers.title: Seafood Safety Assessment of Heavy Metals in Commercial Marine Species Purchased in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia: Implications for Non-Carcinogenic Risks
papers.authors: Al-Mur, Bandar A.
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: This study assessed the concentrations of Cd, Pb, Cu, Zn, Ni, Cr, Mn, and Fe in edible tissues of seven commercially important seafood species purchased from the central fish market in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Metal concentrations differed significantly among species (p < 0.05). Mean metal concentrations decreased in the order Fe > Zn > Cu > Cr > Mn > Ni > Pb > Cd. Overall accumulation ranking: Crustaceans > Mollusks > Cephalopods (species-dependent). The concentrations of Pb, Cu, Zn, Cr, Ni, Mn, and Fe ranged from 0.262–3.226, 0.949–18.979, 6.549–53.817, 1.007–5.686, 1.037–2.714, 0.791–4.606, and 2.183–77.490 mg/kg wet weight, respectively. Cd concentrations were below the limit of detection (LOD; 0.0234 mg/kg wet weight). Several species exceeded the applicable guideline limits for Cd and Pb. At the same time, the reference values for Cu, Zn, Ni, Mn, Fe, and Cr were interpreted descriptively, as no applicable maximum limit had been established. Individual target hazard quotient (THQ) values were below 1; however, hazard index (HI) values exceeded unity in selected species, indicating potential cumulative non-carcinogenic risks. Overall, the findings demonstrate species-specific variation in trace metal concentrations and highlight the importance of continued monitoring of commercially available seafood to support consumer safety and public health.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究测定了沙特阿拉伯吉达中央鱼市7种商业海产品可食组织中Cd、Pb、Cu、Zn、Ni、Cr、Mn和Fe的浓度，评估其非致癌健康风险。结果显示金属浓度存在显著种间差异，积累排序为甲壳类>软体类>头足类，部分物种Cd和Pb超标，单项THQ均小于1但部分物种HI超过1，提示存在累积性非致癌风险。研究强调需持续监测市售海产品以保障消费者安全。

papers.title: Ecological performance of cultivated and feral populations of an invasive freshwater fish under current and near-future climatic conditions
papers.authors: Storey, Kate; Mandrak, Nicholas E.; Ricciardi, Anthony
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Goldfish (Carassius auratus), a globally invasive species, is increasing in abundance in lakes and ponds within the Laurentian Great Lakes region. We hypothesized that current and future selection pressures imposed on feral goldfish populations adapted to urban and natural ponds would result in elevated ecological performance compared to cultivated pet-store goldfish. We tested the hypothesis experimentally by comparing the foraging efficiency (functional response metrics: maximum feeding rate and handling time) and temperature tolerance (critical thermal maximum, CTmax) of feral and cultivated goldfish under current (18°C) and projected future (26°C) surface water temperatures. After acclimation to projected temperatures, all goldfish populations displayed higher maximum feeding rates and temperature tolerances. Feral goldfish had higher maximum feeding rates than cultivated goldfish at both temperature treatments, indicating higher trophic impact potential. In contrast, CTmax did not vary significantly among populations. Collectively, these results indicate that temperature and intraspecific variation influence the foraging efficiency of goldfish and thus could mediate their ecological impacts. Population-level variation in foraging suggests that selection in urban and natural ponds may increase the ecological impact of introduced goldfish.
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了入侵性金鱼（Carassius auratus）野生种群与养殖种群在当前（18°C）和近未来（26°C）水温下的生态表现，测定了功能性反应参数（最大摄食率、处理时间）和临界热耐受上限（CTmax）。结果表明，升温驯化后所有种群的摄食率和热耐受性均提高，野生金鱼在两个温度处理下的最大摄食率均高于养殖金鱼，显示其更高的营养级影响潜力，而CTmax无显著种群差异。研究表明温度与种内变异共同影响金鱼的摄食效率，城市和自然池塘中的选择作用可能增强入侵金鱼的生态影响。

papers.authors: Coetzee, Vivienne; Parker, Denham; Lamberth, Stephen; Kerwath, Sven
papers.abstract: Abstract Animal body markings such as spots, stripes and patterns play important roles in camouflage and visual communication. This study investigated phenotypic plasticity in the spot patterns of spotted grunter Pomadasys commersonnii , an estuarine‐dependent haemulid species. First, an aquarium experiment ( n = 24) examined plasticity in spot patterns under contrasting turbidity conditions. P. commersonnii reduced their spot size rapidly and reversibly in response to elevated turbidity, with spots returning close to baseline once clear less turbid conditions were restored, whereas the number and position of spots remained constant throughout the experiment, suggesting that spot patterns may be useful for short‐term individual identification. Second, spot patterns of P. commersonnii ( n = 139) from two estuaries with contrasting turbidities were compared. After accounting for body size, fish from the less turbid Breede Estuary had more numerous spots than those from the turbid Kei Estuary and accumulated spots more rapidly with growth, whereas spot size did not differ between estuaries. Spots from the Kei Estuary were, however, more elongated and differently orientated and individuals could be assigned to their estuary of origin with 83.5% accuracy on the bases of spot patterning alone. These findings are consistent with the sensory drive hypothesis, whereby individuals adapt their communication systems to local environmental conditions and indicates that spot size responds plastically to current turbidity while spot number reflected a longer‐term, developmentally accumulated difference between estuaries. Although the precise function of these spots remains unknown, environmental variables such as turbidity evidently play an important role in the phenotypic variation of P. commersonnii .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以河口依赖型石鲈科鱼类斑点鸡笼鲳（*Pomadasys commersonnii*）为对象，通过水族箱实验与野外对比，探讨浊度对其斑点表型的可塑性及种群间变异。实验表明，高浊度下个体斑点面积迅速且可逆地缩小，而斑点数量和位置保持恒定，提示斑点模式可用于短期个体识别。对两个浊度差异明显的河口种群比较发现，低浊度Breede河口的个体斑点数量更多、随生长积累更快，高浊度Kei河口的斑点更细长且方向不同，仅凭斑点模式即可83.5%准确判别个体来源河口。结果表明斑点大小对当前浊度呈表型可塑性响应，而斑点数量反映河口间长期发育累积差异，支持sensory drive hypothesis。

papers.title: Growth-promoting effects of mixed-feeding diets containing microalgae with varying cell sizes and nutritional profiles on juvenile Ruditapes philippinarum
papers.authors: Imai, Hikaru; Kuraya, Kyosuke; Nishijima, Tomoki; Inoue, Takahito; Kurokawa, Kouta; Taga, Shigeru; Hatama, Toshihiro; Kawano, Shuichi; Tanaka, Ryusuke; Yamasaki, Yasuhiro
papers.summary_cn: 研究了不同细胞大小与营养组成的微藻混合饵料对菲律宾蛤仔（Ruditapes philippinarum）幼贝的促生长效果，旨在优化双壳贝类苗种培育的饵料配比策略。

papers.title: Probiotics as sustainable tools for mitigating antimicrobial resistance in aquaculture: A narrative review
papers.authors: Vulla, Kelvin E.; Francis, Beatrice
papers.abstract: The rising crisis of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in global aquaculture threatens food security and public health, calling for a shift away from prophylactic antibiotic use. Probiotics offer a potentially viable and sustainable alternative through competitive exclusion, pathogen suppression, and immunomodulation, thereby helping to reduce disease burden. This review integrates current evidence on the application of probiotics to mitigate AMR within a One Health framework, examining their use across feed-based, water-based, and larval-rearing systems. Across diverse species and production contexts, probiotics may help decouple aquaculture intensification from reliance on antibiotics. However, widespread adoption is hindered by strain-specific efficacy, variable performance across environmental conditions, and logistical challenges associated with maintaining and delivering viable organisms. The field also suffers from a paucity of standardized, long-term, multisite trials, which creates uncertainty about efficacy, durability, and safety under commercial conditions. To address these gaps, emerging innovations such as fermentation-based delivery approaches, synbiotics, postbiotics, and microbiome engineering show promise for enhancing probiotic stability and shaping favorable microbial communities. Probiotics should therefore be viewed as an important component of holistic health management, with the potential to influence resistome dynamics while complementing vaccination and biosecurity measures. Realizing these benefits requires transparent reporting, rigorous ecological monitoring, harmonized regulatory standards, and targeted capacity building, particularly in low- and middle-income countries, to promote equitable access.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述探讨了益生菌作为水产养殖中减少抗生素使用和应对 antimicrobial resistance (AMR) 的可持续工具。通过竞争排斥、病原抑制和免疫调节等机制，益生菌在饲料、水体和育苗系统中均显示出降低疾病负担的潜力，有助于将集约化养殖与抗生素依赖脱钩。然而，菌株特异性效应、环境条件差异及活菌递送等技术挑战限制了其推广，且缺乏标准化、长期、多场址的试验证据。未来需借助发酵递送、合生元、后生元和微生物组工程等创新手段，并结合透明报告、生态监测和监管协调，以推动其在全球尤其低收入国家的应用。

papers.title: More often, less each: Averaging can hide opposing trends in prey occurrence and consumer stomach content
papers.authors: Neuenfeldt, S.
papers.abstract: Abstract Averages of prey mass in fish stomachs are widely used to track changes in feeding. Yet, a mean over all stomachs is the exact product of two quantities—the frequency of occurrence of a prey and its mean content in the stomachs that contained it—which can move in opposite directions. In Atlantic cod ( Gadus morhua L.) in the Baltic Sea, a stable mean benthos content concealed a falling content of consumers and a rising frequency of occurrence, opposing trends that can signal density dependence or responses to hypoxia.
papers.summary_cn: 波罗的海大西洋鳕（Gadus morhua）胃含物中 prey mass 的均值被广泛用于追踪摄食变化，但该均值实为 prey 出现频率与含该 prey 胃中平均含量的乘积，二者可能反向变动。研究发现，稳定的底栖生物平均含量掩盖了单胃含量的下降与出现频率的上升，这种相反趋势可能指示密度依赖效应或缺氧响应。建议在渔业监测中同时报告频率与含量，避免均值掩盖生态信号。

papers.authors: Ye, Zhengwei; Liu, Jiahao; Zhang, Yanjiao; Li, Haoxuan; Bian, Chenchen; Ma, Qiang; Wei, Yuliang; Liang, Mengqing; Xu, Houguo
papers.abstract: Abstract The taste preferences of fish which directly influence the feeding action are diversified among species. The present study evaluated the taste preference of tiger puffer ( Takifugu rubripes ) to a number of compounds including an achiral amino acid (glycine), 16 L‐amino acids, 15 D‐amino acids and seven commonly used feed attractants. A total of 18 intact and healthy tiger puffers (initial body weight 43.33 ± 3.91 g) were randomly separated in nine 100‐L tanks (two fish in each tank as one statistical unit). The test compounds were added in aqueous agar solution to make test pellets. Five parameters indicating the response of fish to pellets, namely, pellet grasp number (GN), ingestion ratio (IR, %), touch span (TS), rejection number (RN) and palatability index (PI), were used for the evaluation of feed palatability, based on which the test compounds were finally identified as attractive, indifferent or repulsive. The Spearman correlation analysis revealed that there was a significant correlation among GN, IR, RN and TS ( p < 0.05). The L/D‐alanine, L/D‐proline, L‐serine, L‐histidine, glycine and inosine‐5′‐monophosphate disodium salt octahydrate, whose IR (over 90%) is significantly higher than that of the control, were identified as attractive ( p < 0.05). This investigation provided basic information about the taste preferences of tiger puffer to potential feed attractants.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以红鳍东方鲀（*Takifugu rubripes*）为对象，通过琼脂颗粒添加试验评估其对甘氨酸、16种L-氨基酸、15种D-氨基酸及7种常用饲料诱食剂的味觉偏好。采用摄食颗粒数、摄食率、触碰时间、排斥次数和适口性指数等指标，结合Spearman相关分析判定化合物属性。结果显示，L/D-丙氨酸、L/D-脯氨酸、L-丝氨酸、L-组氨酸、甘氨酸及肌苷-5′-单磷酸二钠盐的摄食率显著高于对照组（>90%），被鉴定为诱食剂。该研究为红鳍东方鲀饲料诱食剂的筛选提供了基础味觉偏好数据。

papers.title: Applications of broadband echosounders in fisheries and plankton acoustics - a compilation of test datasets
papers.authors: Forland, Tonje Nesse; Kubilius, Rokas; Pedersen, Geir; Korneliussen, Rolf J.; Khodabandeloo, Babak; Malde, Ketil; Bøe, Yngve; Handegard, Nils Olav
papers.abstract: Abstract Broadband echosounders are used by the plankton and fisheries acoustics community to assess distribution, abundance and behaviour of fish and larger zooplankton. Multiple calibrated echosounders can be combined to measure acoustic backscatter across a wide frequency range. This publication presents several example datasets that showcase the diverse applications of broadband echosounders from different platforms like ships, net-pens and towed bodies. These datasets include acoustic targets such as fish, both with and without swim bladders, larger zooplankton, and calibration spheres. Each dataset consists of files from the Kongsberg Discovery EK80 system and includes associated metadata and calibration information. The datasets offer details regarding the objectives of the experiments, provide ground truth information when available, and outline the platform and configuration of data collection and transducers. This collection serves as a resource for testing, developing, and demonstrating data processing methods for broadband acoustic data.
papers.summary_cn: 本文汇编了多组宽带回声探测仪（broadband echosounder）测试数据集，涵盖船舶、网箱和拖曳体等不同平台，目标包括有鳔鱼、无鳔鱼、大型浮游动物及校准球。数据集来自Kongsberg Discovery EK80系统，附有元数据和校准信息，并提供了实验目的及可用的ground truth信息。该汇编旨在为宽带声学数据的处理、测试与开发提供基准资源。

papers.title: Who benefits from sustainable seafood? Examining equity across voluntary sustainability standards in small-scale fisheries
papers.authors: Yadav, Shreya; Hardt, Marah J; Apollaro, Lauren; Mapes-Pearson, Frances; Grantham, Alison; Harris, Blake; Peckham, Hoyt; Mohamed, Abdulla Shakir; Adam, M Shiham; Jerina, Anes
papers.abstract: Abstract Market-based voluntary sustainability standards (VSS) that aim to incentivize sustainable practices in fisheries - such as certifications, improvement projects, and ratings - have proliferated over the past decade. However, with an explicitly narrow focus on environmental outcomes, it is unclear how these programs have affected social equity, and where, and to whom, the costs and benefits of participating in these initiatives accrue. In this project, we conduct a comparative case study using an empirical, mixed methods approach combining interviews, group discussion, and quantitative supply chain analyses to better understand how some VSS (Marine Stewardship Council, Fair Trade, Fishery Improvement Projects) enable, or hinder, equitable outcomes in seafood production. We examine three small-scale fisheries (SSF) in India, Maldives, and Indonesia that differ in size, species focus, and supply chain characteristics, to identify key equity issues (both perceived and realized) and ways in which they can be addressed. For each fishery, we focus on understanding how different dimensions of social equity are impacted by VSS and their interaction with a) international market dynamics and other regional fisheries, b) government policy and contextual or structural issues (e.g., debt, poverty), c) engagement with fishers and fishing communities, and d) the values of seafood organizations operating in a place as they relate to equity. For each fishery and supply chain, we discuss how these dynamics challenge the VSS theory of change and implications for equity. As VSS grow in small-scale fisheries in low-and middle-income countries, it will be crucial for these models to learn from successful strategies and respond to place-specific equity concerns if they are to result in fair and durable conservation outcomes in the long term.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过印度、马尔代夫和印度尼西亚三个小型渔业（SSF）的比较案例，结合访谈、小组讨论和供应链定量分析，探讨 Marine Stewardship Council、Fair Trade、Fishery Improvement Projects 等自愿可持续性标准（VSS）对社会公平的影响。研究发现，VSS 受国际市场需求、政府政策、结构性因素（如债务与贫困）、渔民社区参与程度及在地海产组织价值观等多重因素制约，其变革理论在公平维度上面临挑战。作者指出，VSS 在中低收入国家小型渔业中持续扩展的背景下，须回应地方性公平关切方能实现公正且持久的养护成效。

papers.title: Decoding fish health trajectories across anthropogenically impacted habitats: integrating machine learning approaches for ecological assessment in Pakistan
papers.authors: Hassan, Shoaib
papers.journal: The Journal of Basic and Applied Zoology
papers.abstract: Abstract This study examines the flow and transformation of energy and nutrients using a machine learning-based approach to design scientific experiments, improve precision in aquaculture predictions, and reduce reliance on experimental animals. The model predicts measurable aquaculture-related parameters, including morphometric patterns, macronutrient composition, stress levels, and toxicity. Thus, the Random Forest (RF) ensemble learning approach in modeling complex biological responses in aquatic ecotoxicology reflects the physiological condition of fish across different environments and study sites. The highest average dimensions were observed in specimens from Waste Water sites (III and IV), with a condition factor of 1.49. Proximate composition analysis reveals a significant decline in nutritional quality at these sites, with protein levels dropping to a minimum of 14.56% and lipids to 2.62%, associated with heavy metal bioaccumulation and related oxidative stress, which often results in increased water content (79.87%) at the expense of muscle tissue, following an inverse relationship. While homeostatic control restricted the predictive utility of essential elements, the RF model detected differences among metals and oxidative stress drivers (SOD and CAT) in the first decision nodes at 95.1% cross-validation accuracy. Furthermore, the RF framework automatically categorized geographical risks without regulatory cut-offs by accounting for energy reallocation characteristics (protein or so). Overall, our findings support the Random Forest approach as a high-precision machine learning technique for aquatic watershed risk-indexing and multi-tier biomonitoring. The proposed model could be valuable for fish researchers, scientists, technicians, and farm operators seeking to improve learning and adaptation to new technologies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以巴基斯坦受人为影响的不同水域为对象，采用 Random Forest（RF）集成学习模型预测鱼类形态、常量营养组成、应激水平及毒性等指标，以评估鱼类健康状况。结果显示，废水排放点（III、IV）鱼体条件因子最高（1.49），但蛋白质（最低14.56%）和脂质（2.62%）显著下降，水分升高至79.87%，与重金属生物累积及氧化应激（SOD、CAT）相关。RF模型在95.1%交叉验证精度下可自动区分地理风险等级，支持其作为水流域风险指数化及多层次生物监测的高精度工具。

papers.title: A surprising discovery: microplastics occurrence in half of the wild larval and juvenile fish in the East China Sea
papers.authors: Sui, Yanming; Zhang, Yingying; Chen, Xinya; Feng, Wanjun; Lü, Linlan; Xu, Min; Guo, Haisong
papers.summary_cn: 该研究报道了在东海野生仔稚鱼和幼鱼中微塑料污染的意外发现，约半数样本体内检出微塑料。研究提示微塑料污染可能已广泛波及东海鱼类早期生活史阶段，对渔业资源补充构成潜在威胁。

papers.title: Molecular divergence and genomic composition of B chromosomes in the fish Cyphocharax modestus (Characiformes, Curimatidae)
papers.authors: dos Santos, Natalia; Sassi, Francisco de Menezes Cavalcante; dos Santos, Rodrigo Zeni; Goes, Caio Augusto Gomes; de Moraes, Renata Luiza Rosa; Porto-Foresti, Fabio; Liehr, Thomas; Cioffi, Marcelo de Bello; Utsunomia, Ricardo
papers.abstract: Abstract B chromosomes are supernumerary elements that evolve from standard A chromosomes and are primarily composed of repetitive DNAs, yet their origin, diversification, and molecular composition remain poorly understood in most vertebrates. We investigated two allopatric populations of Cyphocharax modestus (Curimatidae) combining classical cytogenetics, comparative genomic hybridization (CGH), and comparative satellitomics to characterize the repetitive DNA landscape of its B chromosomes. While both populations exhibited a conserved karyotype of 2n=54 biarmed chromosomes, five individuals from the Batalha River (BR) carried supernumerary chromosomes, comprising two distinct variants: a C-positive B1 and an C-negative B2. Comparative satellitome analysis between 3B-carrying and B-lacking individuals identified 116 satellite DNAs (CmoSatDNAs), with the 3B library showing higher abundances of specific sequences. Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) revealed that both B variants share two centromeric satellites (CmoSat01-192 and CmoSat02-108) with the A complement, while CmoSat58-47 was exclusively to B2. Minimum spanning tree analysis of CmoSat58-47 revealed B-exclusive haplotypes alongside haplotypes shared with B-lacking individuals, suggesting a recent origin for these chromosomes. CGH experiments further confirm the sequence sharing between the A and B chromosomes, supporting an intraspecific origin, and revealing substantial genomic differentiation among B variants.
papers.summary_cn: 对Cyphocharax modestus两个异地种群结合细胞遗传学、CGH和比较satellitomics分析，鉴定出116个卫星DNA（CmoSatDNAs），发现两种B染色体变体（C-positive B1和C-negative B2）与A染色体共享着丝粒卫星序列，CmoSat58-47为B2所独有。最小生成树分析显示B-exclusive单倍型与共享单倍型并存，提示B染色体近期起源，CGH证实A、B间序列共享支持种内起源并揭示B变体间显著基因组分化。

papers.title: Potential of Seaweed to Improve the Quality and Shelf Life of Fish and Fishery Products
papers.authors: Rodela, Ashika Banu; Rasul, Md. Golam; Kabir, Ilias Ebne; Hasan, Jahid; Yuan, Chunhong; Majumdar, Bhaskar Chandra
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The rapid growth of the global population has increased the demand for safe, healthy, and sustainable food, and fish supplies about 20% of the world's protein demand. Fishery products are rich in nutrient compositions such as moisture, protein, lipids, minerals, etc. Moisture and fatty acid components that favor microbial spoilage and lipid oxidation are susceptible to post‐harvest losses, leading to compromised food security and economic development. Preservation methods including chilling, freezing, and packaging improve shelf‐life but provide only temporary protection. Although synthetic preservatives are widely used to preserve fish, growing concerns about their potential toxicity have raised questions about their safety. Consequently, consumers are increasingly choosing natural and eco‐friendly preservation methods. Bioactive compounds derived from photosynthetic marine macroalgae (seaweed) are gaining attention on a global scale. Seaweed is considerably rich in phenols, phlorotannins, polysaccharides, pigments, and essential minerals, which exhibit impressive antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. These bioactive compounds can be used as fish ingredients and coatings of fish products, increasing shelf‐life, enhancing safety, and ultimately improving nutritional quality while reducing spoilage. This review summarizes the seaweed‐based preservatives as a sustainable approach to enhancing the quality, safety, and shelf‐life of fish and fishery products, thereby supporting global food systems. In conclusion, seaweeds provide sustainable natural antioxidants and antimicrobials that improve the shelf‐life, functionality, and nutritional quality of fishery products.
papers.summary_cn: 综述探讨海藻作为天然保鲜剂提升鱼类及渔产品质量、安全性与货架期的潜力。海藻富含多酚、phlorotannins、多糖、色素及矿物质，具显著抗氧化与抗菌活性，可减少鱼类产品的微生物腐败与脂质氧化。将海藻活性成分用作鱼类配料或涂膜，可延长货架期并改善营养品质，为替代合成保鲜剂提供可持续方案。

papers.title: Waste Valorisation in Floating Aquaculture Systems: Environmental Biotechnology Pathways and Engineering Integration for Circular Resource Recovery
papers.authors: Ungureanu, Claudia-Veronica; Ungureanu, Costel; Gasparotti, Carmen; Domnisoru, Leonard; Ion, Ion V.
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of aquaculture has led to a substantial increase in the generation of organic waste, nutrient-rich effluents, and residual biomass, creating significant environmental challenges while simultaneously providing opportunities for resource recovery within the circular bioeconomy. Environmental biotechnology offers a broad range of solutions for transforming these waste streams into valuable products, including renewable energy, fertilisers, biochar, microbial biomass, and other bio-based resources. However, the practical implementation of these technologies in floating aquaculture systems remains fragmented due to the lack of integrated engineering approaches. This review critically analyses the current state-of-the-art in environmental biotechnology pathways for aquaculture waste valorisation, covering biological, physicochemical, and thermochemical technologies applicable to floating production systems. The assessment covers anaerobic digestion, composting, insect bioconversion, microalgae cultivation, integrated multi-trophic aquaculture, nutrient recovery, hydrothermal carbonisation, and pyrolysis, together with their technological maturity, offshore applicability, and contribution to circular resource recovery. Beyond reviewing existing technologies, this paper proposes the “Circular Floating Aquaculture Systems Engineering Integration Framework” (CFAS-EIF), a systems engineering concept that integrates floating production infrastructure, waste collection, resource recovery technologies, digital management, and circular value chains into a unified architecture. The framework illustrates how environmental biotechnology can be implemented through coordinated engineering integration, enabling the transition from waste management to resource valorisation in offshore aquaculture. The proposed framework provides researchers, engineers, and industry stakeholders with a comprehensive reference for designing next-generation aquaculture platforms that support sustainable resource management, climate change mitigation, and a circular bioeconomy.
papers.summary_cn: 综述浮式水产养殖系统废弃物资源化的环境生物技术路径与工程集成。文章评估了厌氧消化、堆肥、昆虫转化、微藻培养、IMTA、水热碳化及热解等技术在海上养殖中的成熟度与适用性，并提出“循环浮式水产养殖系统工程集成框架（CFAS-EIF）”，将养殖设施、废物收集、资源回收、数字化管理与循环价值链整合为统一架构，旨在推动海上养殖从废弃物处理向资源增值转型。

papers.title: Study on the Bearing Capacity of PVC Suction Caisson for Marine Aquaculture Cage under Monotonic Inclined Loading
papers.authors: Zhang, Yukun; He, Pingsheng; Li, Dayong; Xiang, Qian; Li, Boxian
papers.journal: Journal of Intelligent Geotechnical Engineering and Foundations
papers.abstract: As marine aquaculture cages are increasingly deployed in deeper waters, conventional foundation solutions are confronted with growing challenges associated with high installation and maintenance costs. This study proposes a corrosion‑resistant, lightweight, high‑strength, and low‑cost PVC-made suction caisson for floating marine aquaculture cages in deep waters. A series of model tests were conducted to investigate the monotonic inclined bearing behavior of PVC suction caissons in sand, considering the influences of the aspect ratio and loading angle on the inclined bearing capacity and failure modes. The optimal loading angle is around 16° and the optimal suction caisson aspect is approximately 2.0, offering the highest bearing capacity at relatively small displacements. As the aspect ratio decreases or the loading angle increases, the motion behavior shifts from rotational failure to vertical pull‑out failure. In addition, the PVC material exhibits a high safety margin in caisson wall strength around the loading point. Results also show that under the same inclined bearing capacity, the PVC suction caisson is the most cost-effective foundation type compared with the steel-made suction caisson and the gravity-base foundation. The application of PVC suction caissons in deep waters for marine aquaculture cages mooring systems exhibits sufficient reliability and promising prospects.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对深水网箱传统基础安装维护成本高的问题，提出一种耐腐蚀、轻质高强的PVC吸力锚（suction caisson），并通过砂土中的模型试验考察长径比和加载角度对单调倾斜承载性能与破坏模式的影响。结果表明，最优加载角度约16°、最优长径比约2.0，此时在较小位移下承载能力最高；长径比减小或加载角度增大时，破坏模式由转动破坏转为竖向拔出破坏。相同倾斜承载力下，PVC吸力锚相比钢制吸力锚和重力式基础更具经济性，在深水网箱系泊系统中具有良好的应用前景。

papers.title: Antimicrobial Resistance Profiles, Resistance Genes, and Their Association with Bacteriophage Susceptibility Among Vibrio parahaemolyticus Isolates from Zhanjiang Shrimp Aquaculture Farms
papers.authors: Iddrisu, Lukman; Chai, Baochen; Mkulo, Evodia Moses; Ibrahim, Salifu; Danso, Felix; Altaf, Muqadas; Khan, Muhammad Fahad; Zhang, Bingyu; Zhang, Shumei; Su, Jiesen
papers.abstract: Vibrio parahaemolyticus is an important foodborne and aquaculture-associated pathogen, and its increasing antimicrobial resistance threatens shrimp production, seafood safety, and public health. Although bacteriophages have emerged as a potential solution to the growing challenge of antimicrobial resistance, whether antibiotic resistance is associated with phage tolerance remains unclear. This study characterized antimicrobial resistance profiles and resistance genes in Vibrio parahaemolyticus isolates from Zhanjiang shrimp aquaculture farms and evaluated their association with bacteriophage susceptibility. A total of 132 isolates were tested against 18 antibiotics, while molecular and phage-related analyses were performed on 132 isolates. High resistance was observed against kanamycin (95.5%), sulfamethoxazole (94.7%), cefazolin (78.8%), imipenem (78.8%), amoxicillin (70.5%), and ampicillin (65.2%). Multidrug resistance was detected in 131/132 isolates (99.24%), indicating an extensive resistance burden. PCR analysis showed high detection rates of aphA (100.00%), sul1 (99.24%), blaTEM (98.48%), blaOXA (73.48%), blaCTX-M (53.03%), qnrA (45.45%), tetA (37.88%), and tetB (21.21%). Phage response analysis showed that 70.45% and 68.18% of isolates were phage-resistant at 4 h and 5 h, respectively. Genes potentially associated with phage–host interactions were also detected, with luxS showing the highest frequency (85.61%). Association analysis revealed significant links between tetA, tetB, blaOXA, and bacteriophage responses. These findings suggest that antimicrobial resistance and reduced phage susceptibility can co-occur among V. parahaemolyticus isolates recovered from shrimp farms in Zhanjiang, highlighting the need for regional resistance surveillance and careful phage selection.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了湛江对虾养殖场副溶血弧菌（Vibrio parahaemolyticus）分离株的耐药谱、耐药基因及其与噬菌体敏感性的关联。对132株分离株进行18种抗生素药敏试验及分子分析，结果显示多重耐药率高达99.24%，aphA、sul1、blaTEM等耐药基因检出率极高。噬菌体应答分析表明约70%菌株具噬菌体抗性，且tetA、tetB、blaOXA与噬菌体应答显著相关，提示耐药性与噬菌体耐受性可共存，需加强区域耐药监测并审慎筛选噬菌体。

papers.title: Postbiotics and Paraprobiotics as Next-Generation Gut Microbiome Modulators in Sustainable Aquaculture Health
papers.authors: Linh, Nguyen Vu; Khang, Luu Tang Phuc; Permpoonpattana, Patima; Dinh-Hung, Nguyen
papers.abstract: Widespread antibiotic use in aquaculture has increased selective pressure on resident bacterial communities, accelerating the emergence of resistance in key pathogens and raising concerns for animal health, environmental microbiomes, and food-chain safety. Reducing dependence on therapeutic antimicrobials requires alternative strategies that remain effective under the processing and biosafety constraints of intensive production systems, where recurrent bacterial diseases continue to cause substantial economic losses. Live probiotics, currently the most extensively studied microbiome-based intervention, have practical limitations, including reduced viability during feed pelleting and extrusion, transient gut colonization, strain-specific host responses, biosafety concerns related to horizontal transfer of antimicrobial-resistance genes, and variable regulatory requirements across regions. Postbiotics, defined as preparations of non-viable microbial biomass, with or without metabolites, that confer a demonstrated health benefit in the target host, and paraprobiotics, which emphasize inactivated whole-cell preparations that preserve surface-associated microbial molecular patterns, may help address several of these constraints. These approaches offer improved compositional definition, greater feed-processing stability, and a potentially more favorable biosafety profile. Because they are non-viable, their anti-pathogen effects do not depend on growth or competitive colonization but may instead involve preformed antimicrobial compounds retained in some preparations, interference with pathogen attachment, modulation of the intestinal environment, reinforcement of barrier function, and stimulation of host immune responses. This review synthesizes current evidence on postbiotics and paraprobiotics in aquaculture, with emphasis on structural classification, pattern-recognition receptor signaling, intestinal barrier function, innate immune priming, encapsulation technologies, and translational readiness. Taken together, available evidence supports postbiotics and paraprobiotics as promising, but not yet fully characterized, alternatives to live probiotics within antibiotic-reduction strategies for aquaculture. Progress toward commercial application will depend on resolving key questions related to dose–response relationships, processing stability in formulated feeds, and species-specific efficacy.
papers.summary_cn: 水产养殖中抗生素滥用加剧了病原菌耐药性，亟需替代性微生态干预策略。本文综述了 postbiotics（非活性微生物制剂）和 paraprobiotics（灭活全细胞制剂）在水产养殖中的应用潜力，重点涵盖其结构分类、模式识别受体信号、肠道屏障功能、先天免疫激活及包埋技术等方面。相比 live probiotics，此类制剂具有成分明确、饲料加工稳定性高和生物安全性好等优势，其抗病原机制不依赖定植竞争，而涉及预形成抗菌化合物、阻断病原附着及宿主免疫调节。现有证据支持其作为抗生素减量策略的候选方案，但剂量-效应关系、饲料加工稳定性及物种特异性功效仍需进一步阐明。

papers.title: Thiobacillus denitrificans enhances nitrogen removal, growth performance, gut histomorphometry, and immunity in fish raised in recirculatory aquaculture systems
papers.authors: Chen, Zonghui; Jiang, Xiaoyan; Sun, Chengwen; Liu, Chunhua; Liu, Zhijun; Zhao, Changchen
papers.abstract: Recirculatory aquaculture systems (RAS) are one of the most sustainable solutions for Nile tilapia, Oreochromis niloticus , production. Nitrogenous waste accumulation has been a major constraint to its usage, especially on water quality and fish health. Effects of Thiobacillus denitrificans on nitrogen removal, water quality, microbial abundance, and growth performance as well as the immunity of Nile tilapia cultured in RAS were examined in this study. Three treatments were prepared that comprised a control (CTR = no inoculation, standard biofiltration, and sulfur pellets as electron donor), a conventional nitrifying biofilter (CNB = enriched with Nitrosomonas and Nitrobacter (1.0 × 10 6 CFU mL -1 )), and a T. denitrificans -inoculated biofilter (TDB = enriched with T. denitrificans (1.0 × 10 6 CFU mL -1 ) for 56 days). Results showed that total ammonia nitrogen ( P = 0.001), nitrite ( P = 0.001), and nitrate ( P = 0.001) were greatly lowered in TDB compared to the CTR, with the lowest levels found in TDB and the highest levels found in CTR. Also, total suspended solids ( P = 0.001) and chemical oxygen demand ( P = 0.001) were significantly lower in TDB than in the CTR group. It is observed that fish on TDB had a considerably increased final body weight (+44.4%) and body weight gain (+49.2%) compared to the control. The addition of TDB in RAS used to raise Nile tilapia greatly ( P = 0.001), increasing TP level accompanied by marked reduction in GLU ( P = 0.001) and CHO ( P = 0.024) and ALT ( P = 0.021) levels. Antioxidant profiles, acetic viscosity, and butyric acid ( P &lt; 0.05) were significantly elevated in fish raised in RAS inoculated with the respective microbial treatments compared to the fish in the control group, as was gut histomorphometry. Also, immune profiles (respiratory burst activity, lysozymes, protease, and esterase activities) were significantly ( P &lt; 0.05) elevated in fish raised in TDB, while the least were observed in the control group. This study demonstrated that T. denitrificans improves nitrogen cycling and removal; water stability in RAS, which results in indirectly induced growth; and enhanced immunity in Nile tilapia, thus offering a promising biotechnological approach for sustainable aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在 recirculatory aquaculture systems (RAS) 中评估了投加 Thiobacillus denitrificans 对尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）氮去除、水质、微生物丰度、生长性能及免疫力的影响，设置对照组、常规硝化生物滤器组和 T. denitrificans 接种组进行56天试验。结果表明，TDB 组显著降低了总氨氮、亚硝酸盐、硝酸盐、总悬浮固体和化学需氧量，鱼体终末体重和增重分别提高44.4%和49.2%，并显著提升抗氧化指标、肠道组织形态及免疫参数（呼吸爆发、溶菌酶、蛋白酶和酯酶活性）。该研究证明 T. denitrificans 可改善 RAS 氮循环与水质稳定性，间接促进生长并增强尼罗罗非鱼免疫力，为可持续水产养殖提供了有前景的生物技术途径。

papers.title: Building digital foundations for aquaculture governance through small-scale farmer readiness in Indonesia
papers.authors: Triyanti, Riesti; Putri, Hertria Maharani; Safitri, Widya; Pramono, Luthfan Hadi
papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦印度尼西亚小规模养殖户的数字化准备度，旨在为水产养殖治理构建数字基础。摘要缺失，具体方法与结果不详。

papers.title: Alternatives to antibiotics for bacterial disease control in tilapia aquaculture: a scoping review
papers.authors: Eltholth, Mahmoud; Adetona, Mutiat Adenike; Famakinde, Damilare O.; Basiru, Afisu; Omotoso, Rodiat Olabisi; Aremu, Abdulfatai; Abubakar, Musa Imam; Sarih, Samira; Furones, Dolors; Garcia-Fruitós, Elena
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦罗非鱼养殖中细菌性疾病防控的抗生素替代方案，系统梳理了益生菌、噬菌体、疫苗、植物提取物及免疫增强剂等策略的研究现状与应用潜力，旨在为减少抗生素依赖、推动可持续养殖提供参考。

papers.title: Does YOLO26 Truly Offer Advantages over Its Predecessors for Edge Deployment? A Benchmark Study in Aquaculture
papers.authors: Ranjan, Rakesh; Kothawade, Gajanan S.; Sharrer, Kata; Tsukuda, Scott; Good, Christopher
papers.abstract: The You Only Look Once (YOLO) has been widely adopted in aquaculture monitoring and management due to its real-time performance and deployment flexibility. The recently introduced YOLO26 architecture incorporates Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS)-free end-to-end inference and is optimized for deployment on resource-constrained CPU-based devices, making it particularly relevant for edge deployment in commercial aquaculture applications. Nevertheless, its performance, operational efficiency, and deployment suitability compared with previous YOLO generations remain largely unvalidated in aquaculture-specific scenarios. This study benchmarks YOLO26 against three Ultralytics predecessors (YOLOv5u, YOLOv8, and YOLO11) across nano, small, and medium model scales for the detection of fish mortality, a critical indicator of fish population health and welfare, in recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS). Twelve model variants were evaluated for detection accuracy, training efficiency across seven dataset sizes, and inference performance on both high-performance NVIDIA A100 GPUs and the resource-constrained, CPU-only Raspberry Pi 5 edge device. All models achieved comparable performance on the full dataset, with mAP50 varying by only 1.25 percentage points across three independent training runs, indicating minimal influence of architectural generation on final mortality detection accuracy when sufficient training data are available. However, notable differences emerged in data efficiency and deployment performance. YOLOv8 demonstrated the strongest training efficiency, achieving 90% mAP50 with only 400 training images, whereas YOLO26 nano and small variants required 1000 images to reach comparable accuracy. In contrast, YOLO26 exhibited advantages during edge deployment, with YOLO26n achieving the highest inference speed on the Raspberry Pi 5 at 7.84 ± 0.13 FPS across three benchmark sessions, while YOLOv5mu outperformed all contemporary medium-scale architectures on CPU-based hardware. These results demonstrate that architectural novelty alone is an insufficient criterion for model selection. The findings support a deployment-oriented framework in which training data availability, target hardware, and inference requirements collectively inform model selection for aquaculture applications.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以循环水养殖系统（RAS）中的鱼类死亡检测为任务，对 YOLO26 与 YOLOv5u、YOLOv8、YOLO11 三种前代架构在 nano、small、medium 三种规模下共 12 个模型变体进行基准测试，评估其检测精度、不同数据集规模下的训练效率，以及在 NVIDIA A100 GPU 与纯 CPU 边缘设备 Raspberry Pi 5 上的推理性能。结果显示，在充足训练数据下各代架构的最终检测精度差异极小（mAP50 仅相差 1.25 个百分点），但数据效率与部署表现差异显著：YOLOv8 训练效率最优，仅需 400 张图像即达 90% mAP50，而 YOLO26 nano/small 需 1000 张；边缘部署方面 YOLO26n 在 Raspberry Pi 5 上推理最快（7.84 ± 0.13 FPS），YOLOv5mu 则在 CPU 硬件上优于所有当代 medium 规模架构。研究表明架构新颖性不足以作为模型选择依据，应基于训练数据可得性、目标硬件与推理需求构建面向部署的选型框架。

papers.title: Process Simulation and Comparative Techno-Economic Assessment of Fish Oil Recovery from Fish Heads via Supercritical CO2 Extraction and Enzymatic Hydrolysis
papers.authors: Hailu, Gebremichael Gebremedhin; Kumar, Anand; Emon, Sharmin Zaman; Rahman, Syed Mohammad Ehsanur; Wang, Zefu; Liu, Yang; Wei, Shuai; Liu, Shucheng
papers.abstract: The valorization of fish processing by-products, particularly fish heads, represents an opportunity to advance the circular economy and reduce the environmental burden associated with organic waste. This study presents a process simulation-based techno-economic assessment of industrial-scale oil extraction from fish heads using supercritical fluid extraction (SCFE) and enzymatic hydrolysis extraction (EHE). Process models were developed in SuperPro Designer (V9.0) for a 50,000 kg/batch facility, integrating mass and energy balances, equipment design, scheduling, and economic analysis. All the results are derived from process simulations and have not been validated experimentally. SCFE yields a relatively high annual oil output (43.03 million kg/year) but is constrained by high solvent costs. EHE produces less oil (34.06 million kg/year) yet shows superior economic indicators, including a higher return on investment (24.77%), a shorter payback period (4.04 years), and diversified co-product revenues (cake, lecithin, soapstock), although it requires relatively greater capital ($862.7 million compared with $846.2 million for SCFE). While a full life-cycle assessment was not conducted, a partial resource inventory assessment indicates that EHE enables a biorefinery approach that improves resource efficiency. A sensitivity analysis revealed that the most favorable batch capacities were 50,000 kg for the SCFE and 150,000 kg for the EHE under the assumptions and throughput range examined. Overall, this simulation-based study underscores the economic and resource-efficiency potential of integrated biorefinery strategies for fish waste valorization, while highlighting the need for experimental validation and comprehensive environmental evaluation in future work.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过过程模拟对鱼头工业化提油的两条技术路线——超临界CO2萃取（SCFE）与酶解萃取（EHE）——进行了技术经济比较，基于SuperPro Designer构建了50,000 kg/批次规模的物料与能量平衡及经济模型（结果均来自模拟，未经实验验证）。SCFE年油产量较高（4303万kg/年）但溶剂成本高；EHE产量较低（3406万kg/年）却具有更优的经济指标，包括投资回报率24.77%、投资回收期4.04年及饼粕、卵磷脂、皂脚等多元副产品收益，尽管其资本投入略高（8.627亿美元 vs 8.462亿美元）。敏感性分析表明，在所设假设与产能范围内，SCFE与EHE的最优批次规模分别为50,000 kg和150,000 kg。该模拟研究凸显了鱼废弃物valorization中integrated biorefinery策略的经济与资源效率潜力，同时指出后续需开展实验验证与全生命周期环境评估。

papers.title: The Effects of Parenteral Fish Oil Supplemented Nutrition on The Levels of DHA, EPA, Cytokines, and Wound Healing in Rats with Full-Thickness Burn Injury
papers.authors: Hassan, Shamsul Kamalrujan; Sharif, Ahmad Sabri; Mohd Zaini, Rhendra Hardy; Wan Muhd Shukeri, Wan Fadzlina
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以全层烧伤大鼠为模型，探讨肠外鱼油营养对DHA、EPA、细胞因子水平及创面愈合的影响。摘要缺失，具体方法、结果与结论无法概述。

papers.title: Effects of shrimp species and salinity in Beta maritima-based marine aquaponics
papers.authors: Nair, Chythra Somanathan; Subramanian, Radhakrishnan; Srinivasan, Vasantha Prabhakaran; Manoharan, Ramya; Nishanth, Drishya; Ahmed, Zienab F. R.; Bhassu, Subha; Subramaniam, Sreeramanan; Jaleel, Abdul
papers.abstract: Introduction Marine aquaponics is an emerging strategy for sustainable food production in saline and water-limited environments. However, most shrimp-based systems rely on Pacific white shrimp ( Litopenaeus vannamei ), while the suitability of regionally important species such as Indian white shrimp ( Penaeus indicus ) remains insufficiently explored. Methods This study compared P. indicus and L. vannamei in a Beta maritima -based marine aquaponic system operated at 10, 15, and 20 ppt for 56 days. The experiment followed a two-factor completely randomised design with three independent aquaponic systems per treatment combination. Shrimp production, plant growth and biochemical composition, and weekly water-quality dynamics were evaluated. Results Salinity and shrimp species affected final weight, weight gain, specific growth rate, feed conversion ratio, and productivity. Shrimp species affected survival, while feed supplied showed a significant salinity × species interaction. Both species achieved greater growth and productivity at 15 and 20 ppt than at 10 ppt. Pacific white shrimp had greater growth, survival, and productivity and a lower feed conversion ratio, whereas Indian white shrimp maintained high survival and improved production at 15 and 20 ppt. In B. maritima , salinity reduced leaf width, final fresh weight, and moisture content but did not affect dry weight. Plants integrated with Pacific white shrimp had greater final fresh weight and relative growth rate. Total chlorophyll remained unchanged, whereas carotenoid, phenolic, and flavonoid contents increased with salinity. DPPH radical-scavenging activity and protein content showed salinity × species interactions. Dissolved oxygen and pH declined over time, electrical conductivity reflected the assigned salinities, ammonia and nitrate accumulated, and nitrite increased initially before declining; water-quality variables were interpreted descriptively. Discussion Pacific white shrimp provided higher production performance, whereas Indian white shrimp remained a viable regional alternative. Among the salinities tested, 15 ppt provided a practical balance between shrimp production, sea-beet fresh biomass, and selected biochemical traits.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在基于 Beta maritima 的 marine aquaponics 系统中比较了印度白虾（Penaeus indicus）与南美白对虾（Litopenaeus vannamei）在10、15和20 ppt盐度下的生产性能、植物生长及水质动态，实验周期56天。结果表明，盐度和虾种均显著影响虾的终重、增重、特定生长率、饲料转化率和生产力，南美白对虾在生长、存活和生产力上优于印度白虾，但印度白虾在15和20 ppt下仍保持高存活率和较好产量。B. maritima 的叶宽、终鲜重和含水量随盐度升高而下降，而类胡萝卜素、酚类和黄酮含量增加；综合虾产量、海甜菜鲜生物量及生化指标，15 ppt为较适宜的平衡盐度。

papers.title: A quantum-inspired YOLOv8 vision framework for high-precision marine debris detection using enhanced Quantum ResNet50 feature encoding
papers.authors: S., Thanushree; D., Suganya; P., Padmakumari; T., Ramkumar
papers.abstract: Marine debris continues to pose a serious threat to marine ecosystems, biodiversity, and coastal economies, creating an urgent need for reliable and real-time detection mechanisms. Despite recent progress, conventional deep learning approaches often exhibit reduced performance in complex marine environments characterized by low visibility, occlusions, and inconsistent illumination. In this work, a hybrid quantum-inspired deep learning framework is proposed to address these challenges by integrating a Quantum ResNet-based feature encoding strategy with the YOLOv8 object detection architecture. The proposed model enhances feature representation by combining classical convolutional features with quantum-inspired transformations, implemented through angle encoding and parameterized quantum circuits. The framework was trained and evaluated on a dataset comprising 3,000 annotated images of marine debris, categorized into plastic, metal, glass, and fishing nets. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves a precision of 93.7%, a recall of 89.2%, and a mAP@0.5 of 91.3%, consistently outperforming the baseline YOLOv8n model by approximately 3%–4% in detection performance. Further analysis under challenging conditions, including Gaussian noise, motion blur, and underwater haze, reveals improved robustness, indicating that the incorporation of quantum-inspired feature transformations enhances the model’s discriminative capability. Overall, the findings suggest that integrating quantum-inspired representations with deep learning models provides a promising pathway for improving both accuracy and resilience in marine debris detection, thereby supporting the development of more effective intelligent environmental monitoring systems.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在解决复杂海洋环境下（低能见度、遮挡、光照不均）海洋垃圾检测性能下降的问题，提出了一种将量子启发式ResNet特征编码与YOLOv8架构相结合的混合深度学习框架，通过角度编码和参数化量子电路增强特征表示。模型在包含塑料、金属、玻璃和渔网四类共3000张标注图像的数据集上训练评估，取得93.7%精确率、89.2%召回率和91.3% mAP@0.5，较基线YOLOv8n提升约3%–4%，并在高斯噪声、运动模糊和水下雾霾等条件下表现出更强鲁棒性。结果表明量子启发式特征变换与深度学习模型的融合可有效提升海洋垃圾检测的精度与抗干扰能力。

papers.title: Predicting the suitable habitat distribution of greater amberjack using the MaxEnt model with fishery and remote sensing data in the surrounding waters of Taiwan
papers.authors: Mammel, Mubarak; Matovu, Baker; Beegum, Sajna; Pokkathappada, Abdul Azeez; Lee, Ming-An; Cheng, Li-Chi
papers.abstract: Abstract The increasing availability of satellite-derived remotely sensed oceanographic data offers significant potential for evaluating changes in habitat suitability driven by oceanographic phenomena and for informing scientific management strategies, particularly when coupled with maximum entropy (MaxEnt) methods. Oceanographic variables, including sea surface temperature (SST), sea surface salinity (SSS), sea surface height (SSH), sea surface chlorophyll-a concentration (CHL), mixed layer depth (MLD), and eddy kinetic energy (EKE), alongside fishery data from Taiwanese fishing vessels, were collected for the period 2014–2019. The MaxEnt model is a widely employed method for predicting species’ geographical distributions by analyzing species occurrence data in relation to environmental variables. Our results indicated that the annual response curves of habitat suitability were significantly influenced by environmental factors. Specifically, optimal environmental conditions for high habitat suitability were identified as SST > 24 °C, SSS < 35 PSU, SSH between 0.41 and 0.64 m, CHL > 0.22 mg/m 3 , MLD is between 10 and 17 m, and EKE < 0.007 m 2 /s 2 . The MaxEnt models exhibited strong predictive performance across all seasons and overall, as evidenced by receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) values exceeding 0.8 and true skill statistics (TSS) values above 0.7, thereby confirming their accuracy in predicting greater amberjack presence, a reference for future conservation and management priorities.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用2014—2019年台湾周边海域的渔业数据与卫星遥感海洋环境数据（SST、SSS、SSH、CHL、MLD、EKE），构建MaxEnt模型预测高体鰤（greater amberjack）的适宜栖息地分布。结果显示，高适宜栖息地的关键环境条件为SST>24 °C、SSS<35 PSU、SSH 0.41—0.64 m、CHL>0.22 mg/m³、MLD 10—17 m、EKE<0.007 m²/s²。模型在各季节及整体均表现良好（AUC>0.8，TSS>0.7），可为该物种的保护与管理提供参考。

papers.title: Predation Risk and Depth Use During Migration of Atlantic Salmon Smolts Through a Fjord Impacted by Hydropower Discharge
papers.authors: Lennox, Robert J.; Vollset, Knut Wiik; Berhe, Saron; Haraldstad, Tormod
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Atlantic salmon ( Salmo must survive the transition from river to fjord in order to migrate to northern latitudes where they feed and grow at sea. In the River Suldalslågen in southern Norway, hydropower regulated water discharge determines the timing and extent of river flows and fjord currents. To better understand how hydropower discharge influences smolt migration, we investigated early marine migration using acoustic telemetry and sensor tags in the fjord during 2 years. Smolts were tagged from the wild and a hatchery facility in 2023 and from the wild in 2024 using ID tags, depth sensor tags, and predation sensor tags and released in the river or towed to the fjord. Once smolts entered the fjord, they moved out to sea relatively quickly, and the route selected was influenced by the river flow from River Suldalslågen such that the northern route was infrequently used during periods of low river flow. Mortalities were concentrated near the river mouth and at one physical bottleneck in the fjord, which coincided with a bridge constructed over the fjord. Predation sensors helped resolve that a share of this mortality was attributable to aquatic predators, likely brown trout ( Salmo and a mix of other marine teleosts. Smolts navigated the fjord mostly close to the water surface, with minimal spatial variation in depth use but some clear diel patterns of moving deeper during daytime. Hydropower regulators should consider how artificial freshets in rivers influence downstream behaviour of the smolts even after exiting the river to the fjord.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在探究水电调节河流流量如何影响大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）smolt经峡湾的早期海洋迁移。研究者于2023—2024年在挪威Suldalslågen河口峡湾使用acoustic telemetry及深度、捕食传感器标签追踪野生和孵化场smolt的迁移路径与深度利用。结果显示，smolt入峡湾后快速入海，迁移路线受河流流量影响（低流量时北侧路线少用），死亡集中于河口及峡湾内一处桥梁所在的物理瓶颈处，捕食传感器证实部分死亡源于水生捕食者（可能为brown trout及其他海洋硬骨鱼类）；smolt主要在近水面迁移，昼夜垂直分布存在明显差异（白天更深）。建议水电调度考虑人工泄流对smolt出河后下游行为的持续影响。

papers.title: Benthic Community Composition of Coral Reefs Is Associated with the Time Since Last Blast Fishing Event
papers.authors: Leitman, Alec Sullivan; Hampton-Smith, Melissa; Growns, Ivor; Bell, Sydney Lyn; Mathias, Raj Heinz
papers.abstract: Blast fishing is a widespread destructive practice that has long-term negative impacts on coral reef ecosystems. To better understand the long-term impact of blast fishing on these ecosystems within Southern Tanzania, in situ surveys were undertaken within a two-year timeframe across six reef sites in Mikindani Bay. These sites varied in the time since blast fishing was last undertaken (<5 years, 5–10 years, or >10 years). While there were limited differences in major benthic categories (soft substrate, algae, and hard coral), multivariate benthic community mix varied significantly with the time since last blast, which explained approximately 25% of the observed variation. This compositional shift was characterized by prominent transitions among major benthic genera including branching Acropora, Euphyllia, massive Porites, and Xenia. This finding suggests that community composition varies across areas with different histories of blast fishing. Coral communities at sites with a more recent history of blasting (<5 years) were largely characterized by a high relative proportion of massive Porites, while sites with intermediate times since blasting (5–10 years) showed a distinct dominance of Euphyllia. In contrast, sites with the longest time elapsed since blast fishing ceased (>10 years) were distinguished by two main taxa; Xenia and branching Acropora. These results suggest that the long-term composition of coral assemblages is highly sensitive to historical blast fishing disturbances. The effective prevention of blast fishing in Mikindani Bay, Tanzania and coral reefs more broadly is therefore critical to conserve the remaining cover, diversity, structure and biological functions of these marine habitats.
papers.summary_cn: 研究在坦桑尼亚Mikindani Bay六个珊瑚礁站点开展两年期实地调查，探讨blast fishing停止后不同时间间隔（<5年、5–10年、>10年）对底栖群落组成的影响。结果显示，主要底栖类别（软基质、藻类、硬珊瑚）差异有限，但底栖群落多变量组成随停止时间显著变化，可解释约25%的变异，表现为分支Acropora、Euphyllia、块状Porites和Xenia等主要属之间的更替。近期（<5年）受blast fishing影响站点以块状Porites为主，5–10年站点以Euphyllia占优，>10年站点则以Xenia和分支Acropora为特征，表明珊瑚群落长期组成对blast fishing历史高度敏感。

papers.title: Cradles of the sea: a global review of shark nurseries
papers.authors: Matich, Philip; Bennett, Mia J.; Byars, Chance L.; Degante, Sobeida R.; Deloach, Thomas J.; Dimas, Erik A.; Dunlap, Andrea K.; Espinoza, Elena J.; Harrison, Emily A.; Hood, Taryn R.
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦全球鲨鱼育幼场（nursery grounds）的分布与特征，系统梳理了鲨鱼繁殖栖息地的研究现状。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与发现无法概述，但标题表明其旨在为鲨鱼保护与渔业管理提供育幼场层面的全球性参考。

papers.title: Fish biology to improve the sampling and conservation of freshwater fish
papers.authors: Britton, J. R.; Sayer, C. D.; Bašić, T.; Tarkan, A. S.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨如何利用鱼类生物学知识改进淡水鱼类的采样方法与保护策略。因摘要缺失，具体方法与结果不详。

papers.title: Solar-geometry-dependent dorsal light reaction explains body roll during circular swimming in farmed yellowtail amberjack
papers.authors: Nakamura, Itsumi; Kawabe, Ryo
papers.summary_cn: 研究了养殖黄尾鰤（Seriola lalandi）在圆形游动中出现的躯体侧倾现象，提出该行为由依赖太阳几何位置的背光反应（dorsal light reaction）所驱动。

papers.title: Investigating the Dynamics of Sex‐Structured Stock Assessment Models Under Sexual Size Dimorphism
papers.authors: Izquierdo, Francisco; Cousido‐Rocha, Marta; Cardinale, Massimiliano; Pennino, Maria Grazia; Silva, Andreia V.; Silva, Cristina; Mendes, Hugo; Cerviño, Santiago
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The integration of separate sexes in stock assessment models represents an advancement towards more realistic modeling of interactions between fisheries and target species. However, increased model complexity can also introduce additional uncertainty into the modeling process. Assuming the same biological parameters for males and females in a single‐sex model may not be appropriate for species with significant sexual size dimorphism (SSD), such as the European hake ( Merluccius merluccius ). In this study, we investigated how single‐sex assessment models assuming biological traits (I) combined for males and females, and (II) the female‐only, compare to the population dynamics of a reference two‐sex model, which accounts for sex‐specific differences in growth and natural mortality ( M ). Results show that single‐sex approaches, particularly the female‐only model, may lead to a different population status, underscoring the sensitivity of assessment outputs and management quantities to sex‐structure assumptions in SSD species. However, when sex‐structured survey data are unavailable, a single‐sex combined model may still provide a reasonable approximation of a two‐sex dynamic. Additionally, the two‐sex model's specific indicators such as sex ratio‐at‐length and operational sex ratio (OSR) provide further insights into stock and fishery dynamics, facilitating more informed decision‐making and enabling the development of fleet‐tailored management strategies. Our findings underscore the need for two‐sex models in species with marked SSD and advocate for investment in sex‐specific data collection and refined diagnostic tools to accurately assess model adequacy.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了在性别大小二态性（SSD）显著的物种（如欧洲无须鳕）中，单性别stock assessment模型（雌雄合并参数及仅雌性参数）与参考双性别模型（考虑性别特异性生长和自然死亡率）的种群动态差异。结果显示，单性别方法（尤其仅雌性模型）可能导致不同的种群状态评估，凸显了评估输出和管理指标对性别结构假设的敏感性；但在缺乏性别分层调查数据时，合并单性别模型仍可合理近似双性别动态。双性别模型提供的体长性别比和操作性别比等指标，有助于深入理解资源与渔业动态，支持针对性管理策略。研究强调，对SSD显著物种应采用双性别模型，并建议加强性别特异性数据收集及诊断工具开发。

papers.title: Customer Relationship Management to Build Trust and Customer Satisfaction in the Social Media Platform-Based Aquaculture Technology Industry
papers.authors: Billa, Salsa; Marsasi, Endy Gunanto
papers.abstract: This study aims to analyze the implementation of social media-based Customer Relationship Management (CRM) in building trust and customer satisfaction in the aquaculture technology industry through the SOBAT Program. The study employs a qualitative approach with a descriptive-phenomenological design using in-depth interviews, observations, and documentation. The analysis is based on Relationship Marketing Theory and Commitment-Trust Theory, which explain that long-term relationships are built through trust as the primary foundation of customer satisfaction. The results indicate that transparent communication, digital education, technical support, and responsive interactions via Facebook can enhance trust, which in turn strengthens customer satisfaction with the company’s products and services. The contribution of this research lies in the development of a Social Customer Relationship Management (SCRM) implementation model based on digital education through the SOBAT Program, which enriches the CRM literature in the aquaculture technology industry and provides practical implications for companies in strengthening customer relationships and creating a sustainable competitive advantage through the integration of digital communication, information transparency, continuous support, and adaptive and sustainable relational strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在分析水产养殖科技产业中基于社交媒体的客户关系管理（CRM）在建立信任与客户满意度中的作用，以SOBAT项目为案例。采用描述性现象学定性方法，通过深度访谈、观察和文献分析，基于关系营销理论与承诺-信任理论框架。结果表明，通过Facebook平台上的透明沟通、数字教育、技术支持和响应式互动可增强客户信任，进而提升对公司产品与服务的满意度。研究贡献在于提出基于数字教育的社交CRM实施模型，丰富了水产养殖科技领域的CRM文献，并为企业在整合数字沟通、信息透明、持续支持及适应性关系策略方面提供实践启示。

papers.title: A new beetle‐specific light trap design reducing flying insect bycatch
papers.authors: Lee, Seunghyun; Kim, Wonwoong; Bai, Ming
papers.abstract: Abstract Passive light traps are widely used in insect biodiversity studies, but they often cause substantial bycatch and non‐target mortality, particularly of flying insects such as Lepidoptera. This indiscriminate killing of non‐target species reduces overall sample quality and increases processing effort. Here, we developed a novel passive light trap design that incorporates a multi‐layer funnel system and behavioural filtering to selectively retain crawling insects while allowing actively flying taxa to escape. The trap was tested across 49 field trials in forest and riparian habitats, comparing its performance with a conventional bucket‐style light trap. The modified design significantly increased the proportion of target taxa (mainly Coleoptera) while effectively reducing flying insect bycatch (e.g., Lepidoptera, Hymenoptera, Trichoptera), without reducing the abundance or diversity of beetles. These results demonstrate that behaviour‐based structural filtering can improve sampling selectivity and efficiency, providing a practical and scalable approach for biodiversity monitoring with reduced non‐target impact.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究设计了一种新型甲虫专用被动光诱捕器，通过多层漏斗系统和行为过滤机制，使爬行昆虫（主要为鞘翅目）被选择性保留，而飞行昆虫（如鳞翅目、膜翅目、毛翅目）可逃逸。在森林和河岸生境的49次田间试验中，与传统桶式光诱捕器相比，该设计显著提高了目标类群比例，减少了飞行昆虫的副渔获，且未降低甲虫的丰度和多样性。结果表明，基于行为的结构过滤可提升采样选择性和效率，为生物多样性监测提供了一种减少非目标影响的实用可扩展方案。

papers.title: The effects of playbacks of anthropogenic noise on the anti‐predator behaviour of Pacific sand lance, Ammodytes personatus
papers.authors: White, Meredith A. V.; Juanes, Francis; O'Hara, Patrick D.; Tavera, Jose; Baker, Matthew R.; Bertram, Douglas F.; Summers, Adam; Fifield, David A.; Carlson, Nora V.
papers.abstract: Abstract Noise from human activities has increased and been shown to negatively impact marine animals. Marine mammals and fish are vulnerable to anthropogenic noise because they rely on sound to communicate, find food, avoid predators and sense their environment. Forage fish are small schooling pelagic fish, important to many predators and instrumental in moving energy to higher trophic levels. There are limited studies investigating how noise influences forage fish behaviour, especially their anti‐predator behaviour. Here, we investigate how noise from boats, pile driving and wind farms affects the anti‐predator behaviour of Pacific sand lance ( Ammodytes personatus , PSL), a key forage fish in the Northeast Pacific Ocean. We exposed PSL to four different noise playbacks and documented anti‐predator behaviour (i.e., burying in the sand and startling). We hypothesized that exposure to anthropogenic noise would increase anti‐predator behaviour in PSL. Contrary to our hypothesis, exposure to boat noise and pile driving noise decreased startling behaviour and burying behaviour, while wind farm noise increased both. These results suggest that different noise sources may impact behaviour through different mechanisms such as noise‐induced stress or distraction and, as a consequence, can both increase PSL short‐ term availability in some contexts while decreasing availability overall. Understanding how fish and their predators respond to different noise sources over longer periods of time is critical in understanding the effects of noise on marine communities and necessary to facilitate recommendations on the management of marine anthropogenic stressors and highlight conservation efforts for coastal areas.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨人为噪声（船只、打桩及风电场噪声）对太平洋玉筋鱼（*Ammodytes personatus*）抗捕食行为的影响。通过回放不同噪声源并记录其埋沙与惊跳反应，发现船只和打桩噪声降低上述行为，而风电场噪声则增强两者。结果表明不同噪声源可能通过压力或干扰等不同机制影响行为，短期可改变玉筋鱼可得性，长期影响需进一步研究，以支持沿海区域人为 stressors 管理和保护。

papers.title: Biodiversity, Fisheries, and Climate Benefits of Mangroves: A Nature-Based Solution for Ocean Ecosystems
papers.authors: Ayassamy, Prisca
papers.summary_cn: 红树林作为基于自然的解决方案，对海洋生态系统具有生物多样性、渔业和气候三重效益。该研究综合评估了红树林在支持渔业资源、保护物种多样性及碳汇功能方面的作用，强调其在缓解气候变化和维持沿海社区生计中的关键地位。结论指出，保护和恢复红树林是促进可持续渔业和海洋生态韧性的重要策略。

papers.title: Assessment of Women Participation in Fisheries Activities in Some  Coastal Communities of Rivers State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Ikeogu, C.F
papers.journal: RESEARCH JOURNAL OF PURE SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
papers.abstract: The study assessed women participation in fisheries activities in some coastal communities in Asari-toru Local Government Area of Rivers State, Nigeria. Data were obtained from 120 women in the study area. Descriptive statistics such as frequency and percentage were used to analyse the data. The results obtained revealed that most (41.67%) of the respondents were between 26 – 40 years old. Majority (62.50%) were married, with the highest (60.0%) family size of 5 – 10. The educational status revealed that 50% had secondary education, 36.67% had primary education, while a few of them (10%) had tertiary education and 3.33% had no formal education. Most (58.33%) of the respondents has been involved in fishery activities for 11 – 20 years and engaged in fishery business on part time basis. The fishing sites ownership status in the study area indicated that the fishing site belongs to the community and not personal. The fisheries activities showed that most of the women (51.67%) engaged in marketing, 29.17% in fish processing, 14.17% in active fishing, while 4.16% and 0.83% were involved in net production and boat construction respectively. Also, majority of the respondents (60.0%) engaged in fishery activities to meet their family needs. The types of fish processing/preservation methods used by the respondents in the study area revealed that majority (75.0%) of the respondents used smoking, and ice block (20.0%). The annual financial returns in the study area showed that 41.67% of the respondents earned between N301, 000-N500, 000. The occupational hazards and risks experienced by the respondents during fisheries operations in the study area indicated that 50.00% of the respondents in the study area affirmed that offensive body odour was as a major occupational hazard and risk experienced by the respondents during fisheries operations, While 15.83% confirmed that it is redness/swelling of the eyes, 14.17% confirmed it is skin rashes/eczema, 8.33% attributed it to Wounds/bruises and emotional trauma/fear of attack and 1.67% affirmed it to boat accident and inhalation of poisonous substances. The constraints experienced by the respondents showed that most of the respondents (63.6%) affirmed that insufficient fund is the major constraint confronting women participation in fisheries activities in the study area. To enhance fisheries activities among the women fisher folks, there is therefore, the need to empower them through granting of loans and credit facilities and capacity building in terms of personal hygiene, healthcare services utililization, and strategic business management. These will go a long way in boosting fish production, improve their sustainable livelihoods and enhance socio-economic status of the women fisher folks in these coastal communities.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了尼日利亚Rivers州Asari-toru地方政府区沿海社区女性参与渔业活动的情况，基于120名女性的调查数据。结果显示，多数受访者（41.67%）年龄在26-40岁，62.50%已婚，58.33%从事渔业活动11-20年，且以兼职为主。女性主要参与鱼类营销（51.67%）、加工（29.17%）和捕捞（14.17%），加工以烟熏法为主（75%），年收入多在N301,000-N500,000（41.67%）。主要职业危害为体味问题（50%），而资金不足（63.6%）是制约参与的首要因素，建议通过贷款和培训赋能女性渔民以提升其生计和社会经济地位。

papers.title: Sustainable Livelihood of Women in Fisheries Value Chain in  Akpaka Axis of Onitsha North Local Government Area,  Anambra State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Enendu, S.C
papers.journal: WORLD JOURNAL OF ENTREPRENEURIAL DEVELOPMENT STUDIES
papers.abstract: The study assessed the socio-economic status of women involved in fisheries value chain in Akpaka, Onitsha North Local government Area of Anambra State, Nigeria. The strength, opportunities, aspirations and expected results were examined. Data collection was done through the administration of 40 structured questionnaires and scheduled interviews. Descriptive statistics such as frequency, percentage and mean were used to analyze the data collected from the study, while SOAR analysis was employed in the deduction of the strengths, opportunities, aspirations and results. The findings from the study revealed that the majority of respondents (50%) were within the active age range of 25–34 years, indicating a relatively young and economically productive population. Most respondents were married (50%) and had attained secondary education (50%), suggesting a moderate level of literacy that could support adoption of improved technologies. Notably, all respondents reported experiencing health and environmental challenges, highlighting significant occupational and environmental risks associated with fish processing activities. The study further showed that fisheries-related activities constituted the primary source of income for most women (82.5%), with a similar proportion engaged on a full-time basis. Fish processing was dominated by smoking, with 100% of respondents processing smoked fish using traditional kilns, despite 95% expressing a preference for modern smoking methods. Marketing was largely conducted through hawking (62.5%), and product demand was generally low (70%), indicating limited market access and profitability. Financial constraints were identified as the most critical challenge (82.5%), compounded by low weekly income levels, with 75% earning less than ₦10,000. Institutional support was notably absent, as none of the respondents reported receiving assistance from government agencies or non-governmental organizations. Participation in cooperatives was also low (15%), limiting access to credit and collective bargaining power. Although gender inequality was reported by only 25% of respondents, it remains a concern within the sector. The SOAR analysis highlighted key strengths such as literacy, skills, and financial independence, alongside opportunities including limited competition and market accessibility. However, achieving improved outcomes requires enhanced government intervention, access to finance, modern processing technologies, and strengthened cooperative systems to boost productivity, income, and overall livelihoods of women in the fisheries value chain.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了尼日利亚Anambra州Onitsha North地方政府Akpaka地区女性参与渔业价值链的社会经济状况，通过40份结构化问卷和访谈收集数据，采用描述性统计和SOAR分析。结果显示，多数受访者（50%）处于25–34岁活跃年龄，82.5%以渔业为主要收入来源，但75%周收入低于₦10,000，且全部采用传统熏制方法，95%偏好现代技术。主要挑战包括资金限制（82.5%）、市场准入低（70%）和缺乏机构支持，建议加强政府干预、融资渠道、现代加工技术及合作社体系以改善女性生计。

papers.title: Correction: Time and spatial trends in landing per unit of effort as support to fisheries management in a multi-gear coastal fishery
papers.authors: Leitão, Pedro; Sousa, Luis; Castro, Margarida; Campos, Aida
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对多渔具沿海渔业中单位努力渔获量（LPUE）的时间与空间趋势进行了修正分析，旨在为渔业管理提供支持。通过评估不同渔具类型的LPUE变化，揭示了资源分布和捕捞压力的时空动态。研究结果有助于优化管理策略，提升多渔具渔业可持续性。

papers.title: Post-Harvest Chemical and Probiotic Interventions in Amazonian Fisheries: An Exploratory Evaluation of Trace Element Dynamics
papers.authors: Moncayo, Valeria; Sánchez-Orellana, Fernando; Maxi, Leiner; Echevarría, Gabriela
papers.abstract: Trace element contamination in Amazonian freshwater ecosystems threatens riverine food security. This study evaluated two post-harvest treatments—ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) and Lactobacillus fermentum—to assess cadmium (Cd) and lead (Pb) variations in edible muscle of four Amazonian fish species (Cichla monoculus, Pimelodus jivaro, Platynematichthys notatus, and Serrasalmus rhombeus). Concentrations were determined using ICP-OES. Platynematichthys notatus exhibited the highest baseline bioaccumulation, whereas C. monoculus showed the lowest. Although main treatment effects should be considered exploratory, distinct species-dependent trends emerged. EDTA achieved the highest Cd reduction in P. notatus (49.78%), while L. fermentum demonstrated notable Cd and Pb reductions in C. monoculus, P. notatus, and S. rhombeus. Conversely, relative concentration increases occurred in P. jivaro under both treatments, reflecting matrix-related effects. These findings suggest that post-harvest efficiency depends on fish species and metal type. Probiotic post-harvest processing represents a promising strategy for reducing dietary exposure to Cd and Pb in Amazonian fisheries, though optimizing operational parameters for community-level applications remains necessary.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了亚马逊淡水鱼类收获后两种处理方式——EDTA化学处理与发酵乳杆菌益生菌处理——对4种食用鱼（Cichla monoculus、Pimelodus jivaro、Platynematichthys notatus及Serrasalmus rhombeus）肌肉中镉（Cd）和铅（Pb）含量的影响，采用ICP-OES测定金属浓度。结果显示，P. notatus基线生物累积最高，C. monoculus最低；EDTA对P. notatus的Cd去除率最高达49.78%，而益生菌在C. monoculus、P. notatus和S. rhombeus中均显著降低Cd和Pb，但P. jivaro在两种处理下出现相对浓度升高，反映基质效应。研究表明，收获后处理效率取决于鱼种和金属类型，益生菌处理有望成为降低亚马逊渔业膳食Cd/Pb暴露的可行策略，但需优化操作参数以适用于社区层面应用。

papers.title: Seeking Benefits or Avoiding Risks? Public Opinion Content and Consumers’ Purchase Intention Toward Aquatic Products: The Case of Basa Fish
papers.authors: Wang, Xiaoyan; Luo, Jianbo; Zhang, Yizhuo; Gao, Xiang; Zhang, Yongxiang; Sun, Yue; Xu, Lejun
papers.abstract: Information asymmetry in aquatic product markets heightens consumers’ perceived food safety risks. Using basa fish as the focal product, this study examined how public opinion content influences purchase intention through perceived benefits and perceived sacrifices, and whether regulatory focus moderates these effects. Based on a scenario experiment, prior basa fish consumers were randomly assigned to positive, balanced, or negative video conditions; the final per-protocol sample comprised 742 participants. Baseline-adjusted analyses showed that positive content produced the highest perceived benefits and purchase intention and the lowest perceived sacrifices, balanced content produced intermediate responses, and negative content produced the least favorable responses. Significant indirect effects operated through perceived benefits and perceived sacrifices. Regulatory focus produced selective moderation: among more promotion-oriented consumers, the positive-versus-negative and balanced-versus-negative advantages in perceived benefits, and the balanced-versus-negative reduction in perceived sacrifices, were greater; among more prevention-oriented consumers, the balanced-versus-negative advantage in purchase intention was greater. These findings clarify how complete public opinion message packages shape consumer evaluations and provide guidance for aquatic product communication and market governance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以巴沙鱼为例，探讨公众舆论内容（正面、平衡、负面）如何通过感知收益与感知牺牲影响消费者对水产品的购买意愿，并检验调节定向的调节作用。基于742名消费者的情景实验发现，正面内容显著提升感知收益和购买意愿、降低感知牺牲，平衡内容居中，负面内容最不利；感知收益与感知牺牲发挥显著中介效应。调节定向产生选择性调节：促进定向消费者对正面与平衡内容的收益感知优势更强，而预防定向消费者在平衡内容下的购买意愿优势更明显。研究为水产品信息传播与市场治理提供了实证依据。

papers.title: Potential and Exploitation Status of Hampala Fish (Hampala macrolepidota) in Lake Singkarak Based on Size Structure and Exploitation Rate
papers.authors: Risdawati, Renny Risdawati; Kasmeri, Ria; ., Abizar; Azri, Harizqi; Rahmad, Hari Adi; Yuhendri, Rival
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF MULTIDISCIPLINARY RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS
papers.abstract: Hampala fish (Hampala macrolepidota) is one of the economically important species in Lake Singkarak, West Sumatra, targeted by local fishers using hook and line, gill nets, and destructive methods including explosives. This study aimed to analyze the potential and exploitation status of Hampala fish based on size structure and population dynamics parameters. Field sampling was conducted from November 2015 to October 2016 using gill nets and hook and line as the primary fishing gear. A total of 951 specimens were measured. Results showed that total length frequency distributions ranged from 54–166 mm (119.01 ± 24.50 mm) for juveniles, 175–405 mm (284.76 ± 37.54 mm) for males, and 167–603 mm (380.38 ± 80.93 mm) for females. Length-weight relationships indicated negative allometric growth in juveniles (b = 2.815) and males (b = 2.740), and positive allometric growth in females (b = 3.105). Total mortality rate (Z) was estimated at 0.835 per year, with an exploitation rate (E) of 0.258. The E value, well below the threshold of 0.5, indicates that Hampala fish in Lake Singkarak remains in a sustainable condition; however, preventive management is imperative given the species' vulnerability to intensified exploitation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2015年11月至2016年10月在印尼Singkarak湖采集的951尾Hampala鱼（Hampala macrolepidota）样本，通过体长结构和种群动态参数评估其资源潜力与开发状态。结果显示，幼鱼、雄鱼和雌鱼均呈异速生长，总死亡率（Z）为0.835/年，开发率（E）为0.258，远低于0.5阈值，表明该种群处于可持续状态，但鉴于其易受过度捕捞影响，仍需采取预防性管理措施。

papers.title: Tributyrin and its importance in fish and shrimp nutrition
papers.authors: Devkant; Ranjan, Amit; Thangarani, Albin Jemila; Prabu, Elangovan; Felix, Nathan; Uma, Arumugam; Sriranjani, Kaliyaperumal
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquaculture faces increasing challenge related to plant-based diets and the sustainability of feed ingredients. Tributyrin, a triglyceride ester of butyric acid, has gained attention as a functional feed additive in aquaculture due to its potential to enhance gut health, immunity, and metabolic performance in various aquatic species. Tributyrin offers a promising solution by improving nutrient absorption, promoting immune responses, and supporting digestive health. While the effects of tributyrin in shellfish remain underexplored, theoretical benefits suggest that it may enhance digestive efficiency and stress resistance. This review highlights the promising role of tributyrin in aquaculture, particularly in promoting sustainable feed practices, while calling for more targeted research to determine its effectiveness across a wider range of species and environmental conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综述了三丁酸甘油酯（tributyrin）作为功能性饲料添加剂在水产养殖中的应用价值，旨在应对植物性饲料和原料可持续性带来的挑战。三丁酸甘油酯通过改善营养吸收、促进免疫反应和维护消化健康，在鱼类中展现出增强肠道健康、免疫力和代谢性能的潜力，但对贝类等物种的效果尚待深入探索。综述强调其在推动可持续饲料实践中的前景，并呼吁开展更多针对性研究以评估其在不同物种和环境条件下的适用性。

papers.title: Environmental DNA metabarcoding revealing fish species diversity in the Zhelin Reservoir
papers.authors: Ma, Qin; Hua, Qi; Wang, Sheng
papers.abstract: Reliable fish biodiversity baselines are essential for monitoring and adaptive management in large subtropical reservoirs. Environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding provides a non-invasive approach for assessing fish assemblages, but molecular baseline information remains limited for Zhelin Reservoir in the Poyang Lake Basin. In this study, eDNA metabarcoding targeting the mitochondrial 12S rRNA gene was used to characterize fish community composition, diversity patterns and exploratory environment-community associations across 14 sampling sites in December 2023. A total of 85 fish taxa were detected, belonging to 6 orders, 12 families and 59 genera, with Cypriniformes and Cyprinidae being dominant.
